cases.title: 30 + 30 suns
cases.line: Two black holes like LIGO's first catch spiral in from 12 Hz; the last orbit takes 27 ms.

cases.title: 48 + 12 suns
cases.line: Unequal masses: the light hole races round the heavy one, and the chirp lasts longer.

cases.title: Eccentric orbit
cases.line: An oval orbit sings in bursts at each close pass, and gravitational waves round it off.
